name: intersect_two_cubes
why: The third value of the enum: only what the two cubes have in common remains, 8 x 10 x 5 = 400 mm3. With this case the three values of `swCombineBodiesOperationType_e` are tabulated on three different numbers -- 1600, 600, 400 -- and none of the three can pass for another.

the volume alone does not say the SHAPE: 400 mm3 can also be made with a long thin part, and the bounding box says that it is exactly the little brick of the overlap
